'''ISD-80''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It oversaw [[Shara Jenn]]'s neurochemical levels after her recovery from a coma induced by [[Star Cabal]].
